description.text:
Scorching Skies (怒炎灼天) was the third enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Sword & Shield series, on sale from 5 January 2024 in six-card packs with two holos, 20 packs to a box. Galarian Moltres V, a Darkness Pokémon whose Ability can attach Darkness Energy from the discard pile, is on its cover.

It brought Single Strike Beedrill, which can Knock Out an opponent's Active Pokémon with Special Energy attached, and Single Strike Emboar; Rapid Strike Malamar and Rapid Strike Inteleon; Celebi and Manaphy, which find Energy and Pokémon in the deck; Kricketune V; Empoleon V, whose Ability turns off the Abilities of the opponent's Basic Pokémon without a rule box; the four forms of Castform; and Impact Energy and Spiral Energy for Single Strike and Rapid Strike Pokémon. Its main cards are numbered out of 66; Character Rare, full-art, Character Super Rare, rainbow and gold cards run to 90.
